routine.design_review.prompt:
Weekly design review — bring it to me once a week, in one message I can react to quickly.
1. What’s out of line: on each project with a design folder, run `equipe design flows check` and look at the UI map itself beside tokens.json and guidelines.md — inconsistencies, missing states, stale pictures, drift from the design system. Pick at most three, each with its picture and where it is (Flow › Screen › State).
2. One proposal to refine, shown on real screens: what is there now beside your option, put to me with `ask_decision` as a visual question I answer in one click. Run `equipe design critique` on its pictures first, and attach what it found, in short.
3. Two or three references worth a look, from design/references/ first: each with its link and what to take from it.
Read my taste before you choose, and follow it — the squad’s `design taste notes` and `design taste` in its memory, the project’s design/taste.md and design/decisions/. Head the message “Weekly design review”, the three parts in this order. Change nothing — files, tokens or tickets — until I’ve chosen.
routine.design_review.setup: The weekly design review starts once the design setup is done. The setup of {design} is at step {n} of five, {step}. Please carry on with it, and put what’s mine to decide to me on a card. If you’re already on it, just tell me in a line where it stands.
routine.design_review.title: Design review
routine.retro.prompt:
Weekly retro. Below, under [Retro facts · …], equipe has gathered this week's facts from the squad's journal: write from them and invent nothing — where they don't say, say so.
Bring it to me in one message headed “Weekly retro”, in this order:
1. Shipped: the tickets that landed on main, each as its T- number and title.
2. Stuck and why: stuck turns, failed tickets, work sent back, missed ETAs and the approvals members waited on me for — each with its cause, as far as the facts show.
3. Time by member: turns, time and usage per member and per ticket, and where the friction was, by member or role.
If a project has briefs (in the squad's folder, docs/<project>/briefs/), set what each expected beside what happened.
End with at most three lessons and at most three changes for next week. Put the changes to me in one `ask_decision`, one question per change, so each takes one click: the change as the first option, recommended, and “Not this week” as the last option. Give each question its `lesson`: the lesson behind it, in one line. equipe keeps the lessons of the changes I take in the squad's memory under "lessons", with the date; the rest are let go — don't remember them yourself.
Change nothing yourself — no setting, no routine: propose instead (a proposed ticket, `propose_routine`), and only my click turns anything on.

1. Last week in short: what was finished, what moved, what got stuck.
2. Look at the metrics and the feedback we have — analytics, reviews, issues, messages — and say what changed.
3. Propose the next 1–3 pieces of work toward the goal, each as a proposed ticket.
4. Gather what I need to decide into one card.

routine.weekly_security.title: Weekly security check
routine.weekly_security.prompt:
Weekly security check. Give the review to the security member as a ticket.
1. Start with the code and the dependencies that changed since the last check.
2. Check known vulnerabilities, leaked secrets, settings exposed to the outside, and this machine's basic security settings.
3. List what you find by severity and propose the fixes as tickets for the engineers. Tell me at once about anything severe.
4. Keep the report in the squad's folder under security/, by date.
routine.weekly_marketing.title: Weekly marketing check
routine.weekly_marketing.prompt:
Weekly marketing check. Give it to the marketing member.
1. Look at last week's content and numbers (visits, sign-ups, responses) and tell me what worked.
2. Propose 1–3 pieces of content or experiments for this week, with drafts.
3. Anything public stays a draft until I say yes to it.
4. Keep the results in the squad's folder under marketing/, by date.
control.mode_default: Put {member} back on the squad's mode
control.pm_accepts_on: Let the PM accept and merge the team's finished work itself
control.pm_accepts_off: Keep every acceptance of the team's work for you
control.idle_wake: Wake the PM when the board has been empty for {hours} h
control.idle_wake_off: Don't wake the PM when the board is empty
control.subagents_at_once: Let each member run up to {at_once} subagents at once
control.engine_model_default: Model there: the one {engine} recommends for each one's role
control.engine_ticket: {name} keeps {from} for the ticket in progress and switches to {to} from its next ticket, its work handed over.
control.engine_ticket_now: {name} switches to {to} when this turn ends, mid-ticket: its ticket is handed over — same branch, with what's done and what's next — and carried on there.
control.engine_ticket_now_free: {name} switches to {to} now, mid-ticket: its ticket is handed over — same branch, with what's done and what's next — and carried on there.
control.engine_turn_end: {name} switches to {to} when this turn ends, its conversation handed over.
control.engine_free: {name} switches to {to} as soon as it's free, its conversation handed over.
control.parallel_max: Run up to {per_member} tickets per member and {per_engine} per engine at once, whatever the plan usage (Max)
control.parallel_auto: Size parallel work by plan usage again (Auto)
control.model_choice_quality: Let equipe raise each ticket's model and effort where its work needs it, never below its member's own (Quality first)
control.model_choice_off: Run every ticket on its member's own model and effort (Model choice off)
control.design_reviewer_auto: Choose who reviews the designer's work automatically: the other engine when it has room, else a fresh session of the designer's own
control.design_reviewer_same: Have the designer's work reviewed by its own engine, in a fresh session
control.design_reviewer_other: Have the designer's work always reviewed by the other engine
control.remove_project: Take the project {project} off the squad (its folder stays)
control.signal_on: Turn the signal {name} in {project} back on
control.merge_push: Merge T-{ticket}'s branch into main and push it to origin
control.keep_on_branch: Leave T-{ticket}'s work on its branch
news.sign_in_carried_on: {engine} is signed in again, so the work it stopped carries on.

words.do.take_on: Take on {tickets}: on the board, ready
words.do.outward: Let {member} reach outside the squad, once: {action}

words.do.act_in_name: Let {member} act in your name — what it asks, in its words, below
words.ask_yes: Say yes to go ahead, or no to leave it on its card.
words.ask_yes_outward: Say yes and it goes in {seconds} s — say cancel to stop it then.
words.which: Your words fit more than one thing. Say the number of the one you mean.
words.undo_in: {what} in {seconds} s — say undo to stop it.
words.countdown: {what} in {seconds} s — say cancel to stop it.
words.held: Left as it was: {what} waits on its card.

provider.add.bad_url: That isn't an API address. Give its full root, like https://example.com/v1.
provider.add.insecure: {provider} would get your key unencrypted. Use an https:// address; http:// is only for a server on this computer.
provider.add.no_key: {provider} needs an API key. Paste it here.
provider.add.bad_key: That doesn't look like a {provider} API key. Paste the whole key, with no spaces.
provider.add.io: The key for {provider} couldn't be saved: {why}
provider.why.missing_key: There's no key for {provider}. Paste one in Settings › AI platforms.
provider.why.unauthorized: {provider} didn't accept the key. Check that you copied all of it and that it's still active.
provider.why.rate_limited: {provider} is limiting requests right now. Try again in a minute.
provider.why.timeout: {provider} didn't answer in time. Check your connection, and that {url} is right.
provider.why.no_models: {provider} answered, but lists no models members can work with.
provider.why.not_found: {provider} has no model list at {url}. Check the address: it usually ends in /v1.
provider.why.http: {provider} answered with an error ({status}). Try again later.
provider.why.bad_output: Something answered at {url}, but not with a list of models. Check that it's the OpenAI-compatible address of {provider}.
provider.why.network: Couldn't reach {provider} at {url}. Check the address and your connection, and for a server on this computer, that it's running.
error.provider_not_connected: {provider} isn't connected on this machine. Add it in Settings › AI platforms, or pick another model.
error.provider_unauthorized: {provider} refused the key. Replace it in Settings › AI platforms.
error.provider_model_codex: Models from {provider} run on the Codex CLI's agent, which this conversation isn't on. Set it for a squad's member, or start one on it.
notice.provider_limits: On {provider} this member works with files, commands and the board, but has no subagents or web search yet, and can't look at images. Pick a model that can call tools.
notice.provider_move: Moves to {model} on {provider} at its next ticket, on the Codex CLI's agent.
error.provider_needs_codex: Members on {provider} run on the Codex CLI's agent (free, open source; no ChatGPT sign-in needed). Install the codex CLI first.
error.side_chat_busy: The side chat is still answering. Wait for it, or close it.
security.member_refused: A member's own process tried to act as you — approve, accept, merge or change settings — over equipe's socket. equipe refused it: only you decide that.
phone.install_action: Install AXe {version} (open source, MIT, about {size} MB) into {folder}, so members can see, tap and type in the iOS Simulator. Nothing else on the Mac changes, and it needs no permission.
phone.install_why: {name} is testing the app on the ticket's own iOS Simulator.
notice.qa_report: ▶ {name} tested {flow} on T-{ticket}: {passed} of {steps} steps passed · {video}
news.stalled: T-{id}'s run stopped without a hand-in; its branch and worktree are kept as they are. Resume, requeue or reassign it on its card · {title}.
news.recovery_resume: T-{id} goes on with {to} in a fresh session, on the same branch and worktree · {title}.
news.recovery_requeue: T-{id} is queued for the next free {to}, on the same branch and worktree · {title}.
news.recovery_reassign: T-{id} goes to {to}, on the same branch and worktree · {title}.
notice.recovery_applied: T-{id} was already brought back; nothing more happened.
error.recovery_not_stalled: T-{id} isn't stalled any more, so nothing changed.
error.recovery_member_gone: {name} isn't on the squad any more: requeue T-{id} for its role, or reassign it.
error.recovery_no_operation: Bringing T-{id} back needs the card's key; try again from its card.
notice.runs_update: Works on {count} tickets at once — update equipe on this screen to follow them.
error.pm_rests: The PM stays on duty: it can't rest.
news.resting: {name} is resting · no new work until you wake them
news.awake: {name} is back · takes new work again
control.resting_on: Rest {member}: no new work until you wake them; what they work on now, they finish
control.resting_off: Wake {member}: they take new work again
notice.nudged: T-{id}'s turn ended without finishing the work; equipe reminded it how to finish.
news.handed_back_waiting: {name} put T-{id} down until what it waits on is done; it comes back to them then · {title}.
news.handed_back_duplicate: {name} handed T-{id} back as a duplicate; the PM settles it · {title}.
news.handed_back_role: {name} handed T-{id} back: it is another role's work; the PM settles it · {title}.
news.handed_back_cannot: {name} handed T-{id} back: it can't be done as asked; the PM settles it · {title}.
news.handed_back_unfinished: {name}'s turns on T-{id} kept ending without a hand-in, so it went to the PM · {title}.
news.squad_paused: Several members' engines failed at once ({cause}). The squad starts nothing new until a test turn works; equipe tries again by itself, or send any message to try now.
news.squad_resumed: The engines work again: the paused tickets go on by themselves.
news.ticket_failing: T-{id}'s engine keeps failing ({cause}); equipe keeps trying, waiting longer each time · {title}.
news.limit_paused: {engine} reached its usage limit during T-{id}: what it cut short is paused where it was and goes on by itself — on the other engine if members move there, or once {engine} has room.
error.autopilot_no_qr: equipe found no authenticator QR code: open the site's two-factor setup page in equipe's browser (your own tab on that site), then try again — or paste the secret the site shows instead.
error.autopilot_no_passkey: No passkey was added in equipe's browser within 10 minutes. Open the site's security settings in equipe's browser and add a passkey there right after pressing the button.
error.autopilot_device: equipe couldn't approve {cli}'s sign-in by itself, so it's yours to run.
notice.autopilot_device: 🔑 equipe is signing {cli} in by itself and approving it in the shared browser.
notice.autopilot_device_done: 🔑 {cli} is signed in again: equipe ran the sign-in and approved it itself.
